prompts.answer: Answer by copying the relevant single text span from the page, including any units. Do not explain.
prompts.fresh_context: The first image is the full page. The second image is an enlarged region of the first image.

protocol.source_panel_role: Known development reports after observed v3/v4 results; prior quality filter plus reference-guided ROI eligibility; not held out.
protocol.execution_lock_requirement: Fill document/inference hashes and both timestamps after final review, before any v5 smoke or main inference.

roi.reject_boundary_fragments: Any omitted alphanumeric character or hyphen variant; punctuation-only fragments allowed.
roi.coordinates: OCR CropBox top-left to source MediaBox render top-left, with recorded scales and offsets
roi.ocr_aspect_tolerance: abs(ow*ch-oh*cw)<=cw+ch; at most one OCR raster-pixel rounding error per axis
roi.degraded: BICUBIC resize of projected floating-point source ROI from the corresponding overview only, matched native output size

analysis.metric_change_from_v4: Prospective primary switch from conservative text EM to pinned official empty-scale single-span EM; earlier primary findings unchanged.
analysis.confidence_interval: 95% paired percentile; exploratory/unadjusted; all ten actions resampled together
analysis.source_quality_sensitivity: None: frozen prior94 quality filter is applied before ROI eligibility; primary is all85 eligible reports.

candidate_gate.usage: Only motivates untouched-data validation with a nonprivileged selector; semantic audit also required.

semantic_audit.selection: All native256/degraded256 parsed-answer changes; additionally differing raw responses when either parse is invalid. Include official both-correct and both-wrong pairs.
semantic_audit.display: Original full source page, question, unchanged reference, complete raw A/B responses; hide condition identities and scores until judgments are locked.
semantic_audit.role: Descriptive condition-blinded qualitative check, separate from independent expert validation, formal statistical testing and score revision

analysis.near_zero_variance_caveat: Narrow/collapsed empirical intervals do not establish population equivalence or absence of rare unseen effects.
analysis.upstream_metric_limitation: Official normalization can erase formatting, units/sign distinctions; raw content audit required. No gold scale injected into predictions.

execution.warmup_description: Synthetic landscape/square/portrait direct_256 and native_256; nonexhaustive shapes
execution.action_order: Per-example seeded shuffle of all ten independent actions
execution.main_outcome_inspection: Only after all850 declared records complete

cost_scenarios.primary_standalone: Each action is one fresh VLM invocation; no direct answer required by regional input.
cost_scenarios.secondary_decision_state: Regional branch plus matching direct_b; peak memory max of both. Direct and highres standalone.
cost_scenarios.localization_cost: Reference-associated ROI is privileged and unavailable to a deployed selector; annotation/preparation costs excluded from VLM-call latency and disclosed separately.
